messages:
lia: Heads-up: EU customer submitted a formal DSAR asking for full deletion (PII + embeddings + search index entries). Legal gave 30 days. Can we do full wipe and produce an auditable proof?

oscar: We can, but need to verify backups and cold snapshots. Provider snapshot retention policies might block immediate destruction.

ravi: Two immediate tech blockers: 1) KMS key versions used for older blobs might be disabled, 2) only service account `dsar-runner` has delete role.

mina: Also check whether this tenant has a pending vuln triage or forensics hold. If there's an active incident we might be blocked. @legal-bot any holds?

legal-bot: No active legal hold for tenant. DSAR accepted. Deadline: 2026-04-20.

sec-bot: Ticket created: PRIV-2026-117 (auto) 

oscar: Action plan: dry-run to produce a signed deletion manifest (sha256 of manifest + list of object paths), run canary (n=5), then full job. We must redact customer_id in public artifacts.

ravi: KMS detail: embeddings were encrypted using `projects/redwood/locations/europe1/keyRings/embeds/cryptoKeys/eu-embeds` with versions 1..4. If older versions are disabled we need decrypt grants from KMS admin or use key backup to unwrap.

mina: Proposal for RBAC: temporarily grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to key, and `roles/storage.objectAdmin` on audit-bucket to `serviceAccount:dsar-runner@`. TTL 6 hours. Record the principle and expiry in the PR.

lia: Legal ok with temporary grants if approvals and expiry are logged. Also need chain-of-custody and attestations signed by privacy counsel.

oscar: Will add attestation template and required fields: operator, deleted_paths, deleted_at (ISO8601), manifest_sha256, dsar_ticket, approver. Store under `gs://redwood-audit/privacy/PRIV-2026-117/`. Enable object-level logging.

ravi: One more: search index entries and telemetry ingestion need to be scrubbed. We can run a delete+reindex for the tenant id. Reindex will be CPU heavy. Schedule during maintenance window 03:00-05:00 UTC.

mina: Backups: cloud provider has a 7-day immutable snapshot window for region eu-west1 for some managed DBs. We need to enumerate: snapshots, cold-archive (glacier style), replicated archives in other regions. If immutable, mark as retention exception and log mitigation, else delete.

lia: Who will run the key access audit? @ravi please pull key usage logs and confirm key versions still enabled. Also check HSM/attestation logs if wrapped with HSM.

ravi: On it: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=eu-embeds --location=europe1` then check `audit_logs` for decrypt operations. I'll run a dry-run using `--no-op` flag that produces the proof file but doesn't delete.

oscar: Canary plan: 1) Dry-run produce manifest, 2) Grant temp IAM, 3) Delete 5 embed objects, 4) Verify search index no longer returns those docs, 5) Upload attestation, 6) Revoke temp IAM.

mina: RBAC PR checklist: include ticket id, approver (privacy counsel), expiry timestamp, change justification, and a rollback plan. Also include logs that show who triggered revocation.

lia: Customer comms: I'll draft email template confirming deletion and attestation availability after completion. Will CC legal.

sec-bot: Reminder: ensure audit entries are immutable. Use signed object storage and cross-check manifest hash in the audit ledger.

ravi: Forensics question: if later asked for proof we should be able to show deletion artifact + KMS audit logs proving decrypt calls and IAM grant timestamps. We'll attach those to PRIV-2026-117.

oscar: Edge case: some embeddings were exported to third-party analytics for billing. Need to enumerate downstream consumers and request deletion. I'll open a follow-up ticket for data propagation cleanup.

mina: Summary of immediate tasks:
- @ravi: key usage logs + dry-run proof (no-op)
- @oscar: open temp IAM grant PR with 6h TTL + include DSAR ticket
- @mina: enumerate backups & note immutable archives, flag exceptions
- @lia: customer communication draft + final attestation sign-off

lia: I'll start the comms and post the draft here. Will wait for dry-run artifact before emailing. Thanks team :pray:

sec-bot: PRIV-2026-117 updated: dry-run proof uploaded (pending attestation).
